evaluations.note: 9 on the reference machine. BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 at eval 7 (1.015561e-01, the best) and takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9); its next step, held to the box, cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search ("DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached"; the journal says "the line search is not run" and DIAGNOSTICS "Line searches not run : 1"). 1.5.0's fingerprint had 16 evaluations.

tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances, and the evaluation count exactly: the optimum is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 7), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9), and its next step, held to the box, cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default), after 9 evaluations. No point is evaluated twice, so no decision of the search compares two relaxations of one point, which differ at the rounding level (~1e-13 relative: each PC_LAMMPS --hotvar relaxation starts from the value of the best evaluation so far).
